Russell to Suryakumar, SIX runs 
Suryakumar finishes it the only way he can - with another trademark stroke! And 
Mumbai register another trademark win against the Kolkata Knight Riders, and this is a 
result that will reverberate around the IPL! Back of a length just outside off. Not sure 
how Suryakumar does it, but no one in the world does this better than him. Gets down 
low and then helps it over the keeper's head. A bruising and clinical display and Mumbai, 
truth be told, have blown the defending champions out of the water tonight! 
Another night to forget for KKR at the Wankhede Stadium. They were outplayed in each 
and every department, and will have to go back home, and to the drawing board with 
lots to ponder, including if their combination needs tweaking, or if they need better 
contingency plans. 
10:24pm And then there were none. Each team now has a win on the board, and MI, 
tonight, did it in some style. Their bowlers teed it up, which would have been very 
pleasing, given they almost conceded 200 to the Titans a few days ago, and then their 
batters thrived, despite the ball doing all sorts at the start. Rickelton led the way, 
registering his maiden half-century and Suryakumar added the finishing touches, 
continuing on from the spark he displayed in Ahmedabad on Saturday. 
Ryan Rickelton: (On taking his time at the start) Didn't take my time, could not lay bat on 
it (smiles). It was nibbling around quite a lot, lucky to get a few away (at the start) to 
calm me down. (On the pitch having pace and bounce) Most definitely. Chatting to the 
guys (in South Africa) about playing here…looking forward to get out here again and 
maximizing the pace. It is unbelievable. Have never been to the Wankhede. To see the 
whole stadium turn blue, to play alongside Hardik, Rohit and SKY - to see how much 
they are adored in Mumbai is special, definitely going to enjoy my time here and special 
place to be. They (the bowlers) executed really well, quick to realize the lengths we 
needed to bowl, bowled phenomenally to restrict that team to 120. (On Suryakumar's 
trademark sixes towards the end) I just said to Quinny when he walked past that he 
(Suryakumar) is a joke. Stuff that I can only dream of. He has played that shot a million 
times - it is a unique shot and definitely not going to try it anytime soon, but glad he is 
on our team. 
Ajinkya Rahane, Kolkata Knight Riders captain: Collective batting failure, it was a good 
wicket to bat on. 180-190 would have been a good total on this pitch. We expect that 
(here), it has good bounce. When you are fighting against the bounce, that is what we 
did, you have to use it sometimes - we have to learn really fast. Bowlers were trying their 
best but not much runs on the board. We kept on losing wickets - four in the powerplay 
and after that, it was difficult to consolidate. You need one batter to bat through and 
stay till the end but that did not happen. 
Hardik Pandya, Mumbai Indians captain: Very satisfying. To win, especially at home 
and the way we did it as a group - everyone chipped in, cannot be happier. It is always a 
challenge of picking one guy here or there. Our team is sorted with the players we are 
backing and the players we have. We thought Ashwani can come in (on this pitch) and 
bowl the way he bowled. It is all scouts - they picked him. They have gone to all the 
places and picked these young kids. We played a practice game, he had that zip, that 
late swing, something off the wicket, a different action and he was a leftie. We just 
backed him and the way he took that wicket of Russell was a very crucial wicket, and 
how he started with the catch of de Kock, it was terrific to see (a fast bowler jumping up 
to take it). When it goes my way, it looks good. But the kind of team we have, we have a 
lot of young and experienced players combined and I do not have to worry much. Early 
start, but a great sign for everyone to chip in and kick off the tournament for us. 
Ashwani Kumar, Player of the Match: It is a big thing for me that I got this opportunity 
and that I am getting this award. Never thought about this, just did my process and 
happy (to get this award). I am from Jhanjheri in Mohali district - to come from there to 
here, that is the result of my hard work and by god's grace I am here. I was confident, 
but I was a little nervous as well, thinking about what will happen. (On his message to 
his people back home) I want to make all of you feel proud in the upcoming games. 
10:50pm That will be all from us for this game. We will be back again tomorrow, nice 
and early and LSG welcome the Punjab Kings. Until then, this is goodbye from Sudeep, 
Thilak and myself. Take care, everyone!
